data: Does the BLEU EN value decrease as the cosine similarity between the gradients becomes more negative?

The question asks whether the BLEU EN value decreases as the cosine similarity between the gradients becomes more negative. From the caption, we know that the collapse of the BLEU En matches the negative cosine similarity. This means that as the cosine similarity becomes more negative, the BLEU EN value also decreases. Therefore, the answer is yes.
